layers.name: LIDAR Composite 1m LZ DSM 2022 extents
layers.purpose: shows which time-stamped LIDAR surveys were used in the Composite 1m Last Return DSM for any location

layers.name: LIDAR Composite 1m DTM 2022 extents
layers.purpose: shows which time-stamped LIDAR surveys were used in the Composite 1m DTM for any location

local_use: Local OpenCode intersects canonical building-bearing parcels with both official polygon layers, selects the matched DSM and DTM source filenames/survey identifiers, then computes parcel min/max/mean/max-min. No parcel computation is performed here.
limitations: Source-area evidence only; not an accepted Layer24 parcel record.
No canonical parcel geometry/AOI is available on this page.
No FeatureServer geometry query or raster statistics are claimed.
